records.description: PULSE predicts people counts at places across Japan now, 1 hour ahead and 2 hours ahead. Explore a map, search or ask in chat to find quieter places or livelier venues. Free on iPhone; no account needed. Currently in Japanese. Developed with GPT through Codex and Claude, with over 3 billion data records and 2.6 billion record-level prediction comparisons.

records.name: Mekugi
records.tagline: Make Codex provider better AX and UX
records.description: Mekugi pins compact agent tools onto stock Codex: hashline edits, direct scripts, and inline subagent activity. Codex keeps the sandbox, permissions, command sessions, and patch diff UI. No fork, no config edits, no daemon.

records.name: Boldloom
records.tagline: Free LinkedIn text formatting tools
records.description: Turn plain text into bold, italic, and styled Unicode text that pastes directly into LinkedIn posts, comments, and profile fields. No browser extension, no account, no sign-up — just type, copy, paste.

records.name: 100Arena
records.tagline: Run Your Entire Sports Facility From One Place
records.description: The premier sports related software for booking, playing, managing, and growing your sports facility. The all-in-one platform for arenas, courts, and fields.

records.name: MiniTune
records.tagline: Spotlight for your music - search & play from anywhere.
records.description: A native macOS notch mini player for YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music & Local Files. Spotlight Search from anywhere, play your YouTube playlists, access favourites, recently played and time-synced lyrics. No tab hunting anymore.

records.name: YOU HAD ONE JOB
records.tagline: Have a website? We'll tell you how badly it's behaving.
records.description: Add your website and we will tell you how badly it is behaving. A free check of performance, security headers, SEO, accessibility and general tidiness.

records.name: GeoBlood
records.tagline: Real-time blood donor matching, built to save lives
records.description: GeoBlood connects blood donors with patients in real time. When someone needs blood, GeoBlood finds compatible, opted-in donors nearby and alerts them instantly — turning hours of frantic calling into minutes. Built as native iOS and Android apps (not React Native), backed by Google for Nonprofits, Microsoft, and Apple. GeoBlood is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, free for donors and patients alike, built to work anywhere blood shortages cost lives.

records.name: subba
records.tagline: Never miss another customer.
records.description: subba is the AI receptionist and booking system for local businesses. It answers every enquiry in seconds, books customers into your diary, and takes payment, in your voice. We can even build your booking website and domain, live in 5 working days.

records.name: Corevilla™
records.tagline: Property management made simple
records.description: Corevilla is now live!. A simple and affordable property management platform built for landlords and property managers. Manage properties, units, tenants, contracts, rent payments and maintenance requests all in one place. It caters for shared properties and room by room rentals. No complicated packages or unneccessarily extras. Just €2 per unit per month. No hidden fees.
